arguments.message:
Sure! To set up an automated weekly export:
1. Go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**.
2. Click “Add schedule” (or similar) and choose the data you want to export.
3. Pick **Weekly** as the recurrence.
4. Select the export format you need (CSV, native tool format, etc.).
5. Connect a cloud storage destination via the OAuth link (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.).
6. Save the schedule.
That will automatically run the export every week and drop the file into your chosen cloud folder. Let me know if you need help with any of the steps!
